title: Local Frobenius characteristic polynomial of a powered geometric pullback
statement: Let $k_1/k_0$ be finite fields, $\ell$ a prime invertible in both, and $r>0$ with $|k_1|=|k_0|^r$. Let $X/k_0$ and $C/k_1$ be locally finite-type schemes, and let $c:C\to X$ commute with the structure morphisms and $\operatorname{Spec}(k_0\to k_1)$. Fix $\tau:\overline{k_0}\simeq\overline{k_1}$ compatible with $k_0$. Let $u:\bar C\to\bar X$ [def-pc-base-change] commute with $c$ on the scheme projections and with $\operatorname{Spec}\tau$ on the closure projections, and satisfy $u\circ\operatorname{Fr}_C=\operatorname{Fr}_X^r\circ u$. Let $P$ be the explicit powered geometric pullback [def-zl-powered-geometric-pullback]. For any finite point $s$ of $C$, there exist a finite point $x$ of $X$ and $e>0$ such that $c(s)=x$ and $q_s=q_x^e$, where $q_a=|\kappa(a)|$. Simultaneously for every constructible source Weil sheaf $G$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], one has $\det(T-F_{s,P(G)})=\det(T-F_{x,G}^{\,e})$ for the local Frobenius endomorphisms [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. There is no lissity or semisimplicity assumption, and no curve, diagram, simplicity or reality descent is asserted.

proof.text: Construct x=c(s) using Finite.of_injective applied to the residue-field embedding. Give kappa(s) its algebra structure over kappa(x) from c.residueFieldMap and set e to its finrank. Field nontriviality gives e>0, and Module.natCard_eq_pow_finrank gives the residue cardinality identity. Rewrite it using the cardinalities of k0 and k1 to obtain r*degree(s)=degree(x)*e by injectivity of powers of |k0|>=2. Thus degree(x) divides r*degree(s) and the quotient is e. This part is completely proved in Lean.

proof.text: Let t be the chosen geometric lift of s and a=Spec(tau inverse). The finite-field Frobenius power formula gives a sigma1^ds = sigma0^(r*ds) a. Combine this with the power of hu to show a t u returns under Fr_X^(r*ds). The projection square hup puts it over x. The existing charpoly_frobeniusEnd_stalkAt_of_dvd compares its source Frobenius with F(G,x)^e, accounting for the potentially different canonical lift. This part is completely proved in Lean.

proof.text: Apply the iterated Weil-map square [lem-zl-powered-geometric-pullback-iterate] at m=degree(s). Define T from the source stalk at a t u to the pulled-back stalk at t by globalSectionsTransport along Spec(tau), using the canonical carrier isomorphism. It is an isomorphism because Spec(tau) and the carrier map are isomorphisms. The two globalSectionsTransport composition laws, the iterated Weil-map square and commutation of the point Frobenii show T F_source = F_pullback T. Convert T to a linear equivalence and then to FrobeniusModule.Equiv; its characteristic polynomial equality, composed with the preceding source comparison, proves the original simultaneous assertion. All stalk transport, conjugacy and characteristic polynomial glue is completely proved in Lean.

theorem poweredGeometricPullback_stalk
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    [Algebra k₀ k₁] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] [Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)]
    {X C : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [C.Over (Spec (.of k₁))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁))]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hcard : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (τ : AlgebraicClosure k₀ ≃+* AlgebraicClosure k₁)
    (hτ : ∀ a : k₀, τ (algebraMap k₀ (AlgebraicClosure k₀) a) =
      algebraMap k₁ (AlgebraicClosure k₁) (algebraMap k₀ k₁ a))
    (c : C ⟶ X)
    (hc : c ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)) =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁)))
    (u : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    (hup : u ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberProj =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberProj ≫ c)
    (huτ : u ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom))
    (hu : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom ≫ u =
      u ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom)
    (s : C.finitePoints) :
    ∃ (x : X.finitePoints) (e : ℕ), c s.1 = x.1 ∧ 0 < e ∧
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).residueCard s.1 =
        (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).residueCard x.1 ^ e ∧
      ∀ G : WeilSheaf k₀ l X,
        (((poweredGeometricPullback u r hu).obj G).stalk s).frobeniusEnd.charpoly =
          ((G.stalk x).frobeniusEnd ^ e).charpoly
